points.title: Build system and reproducibility

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements solve CLI and raw run_status records production commands.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, numerics, drivers, output, and case IO modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal wrapper/executable invocation was found; trust policy applied without external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON parsing and generic mesh/tag paths are present; no case-filename-only branch found in reviewed source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS ownership/ghost structures and neighbor Isend/Irecv appear in source; raw outputs report 8 ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback and finite checks exist, but Re200 accepts a mere inner-residual decrease as convergence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: README documents checks and raw package validates structurally; no independent clean build/rerun evidence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated result contains source, documented scripts, TeX and referenced PNGs only; raw artifacts excluded.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative compressible NS state/closure and residual paths are documented and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS zones, mixed cells, boundary tags, face geometry and adjacency are represented in mesh modules.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based residual assembly and global norms are present.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and viscous corrected-central paths are present; accuracy is limited by dissipation.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic treatments are documented and source-backed.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares primitive reconstruction is called before interior-face fluxes.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiter and reconstructed-state positivity fallback are active source paths.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Gradient, Newtonian/Fourier, wall treatment and force split code are present.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Block-Jacobi/LU-SGS pseudo-time paths and CFL controls are source-backed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 outer loop/frozen histories exist, but Re200 exits at five iterations when residual merely decreases, not at the stated 1e-3 target.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph partitioning, owned/ghost state, Isend/Irecv and reductions are present; no evaluator rank rerun.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight raw output directories and report passed explicit validator in detached attempt worktree.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: validate_outputs.py returned success for eight named final directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All packages are readable and complete; Re200 target-convergence claim is contradicted by source and last ratio 0.3696.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Fields/figures and force histories are delivered, but many steady residual reductions are below two orders and Re200 spectrum is admitted broad-band.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Curated referenced figures cover histories, Cp and fields; some zoom figures were excluded as unreferenced and report prose has a Re20/Re200 vorticity typo.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report has methods, tables, figures and limitations, but overstates strict Re200 inner convergence/statistical confidence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Raw report includes manifests/sanity checks and validator passes; curated TeX retains referenced figures.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Documented CMake/CLI and all raw packages structurally validate; clean evaluator build not performed.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured/multizone/tag and adjacency implementation is source-backed.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative Rusanov residual and three required boundary classes are present; no independent numerical rerun.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: WLS reconstruction, Barth limiter and positivity fallback are active source paths; no independent smooth-order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous gradients/stress/heat/wall and force splitting are implemented and reported.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit steady and BDF2 dual-time structure exists, but Re200 falsely treats residual decrease as target convergence and caps at 60 despite configured 1000.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, rank-local ownership, halos and reductions are source-backed; raw data show eight-rank final cases but no evaluator MPI comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Eight readable validated packages include fields; steady reductions are modest and Re200 does not demonstrate the stated strict inner target.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Substantial TeX report and traced figures with honest broad-band/plateau limitations, but Re200 interpretation and one vorticity reference are weak.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular case/mesh/numerics/output interfaces support stated extensions.
